cli.usage:
Usage: roadmap-live [command] [file] [options]

Commands:
  (none)                 start the live server (default)
  sync                   read pull request activity from GitHub and update the roadmap
  render                 write a static HTML page from the current state
  init                   create roadmap.json, AGENTS.md and the workflow file
  auth                   log in to GitHub in the browser (--logout removes the token)
  doctor                 explain which GitHub credential and which provider would be used

Options:
  file                   path to roadmap.json (default: ./roadmap.json)
  --port <n>             HTTP port for the live server (default: 4242)
  --key <secret>         write key for the live page (default: generated at start, or ROADMAP_KEY)
  --check                validate the file and exit with 0 (ok) or 1 (problems)
  --repo owner/name      repository for sync (default: sync.repo, GITHUB_REPOSITORY or the git remote)
  --dry-run              sync: print the planned changes and write nothing
  --apply                sync: apply .roadmap-live/result.json written by your coding agent
  --provider <name>      sync: anthropic, claude-cli, codex-cli, gemini-cli or agent
  --public               auth: ask for the public_repo scope only
  --out <path>           render: output file (default: roadmap/index.html)
  --theme <name>         render: neutral, paper, mono or a file in roadmap-themes/
  --mode light|dark      render: fix the color mode instead of following the system
  -h, --help             show this help
cli.checkParallel: note: {n} items are active at the same time
cli.checkLarge: note: {file} is {kb} KB, trim old comments and notes yourself (the agent never deletes comments) so the agent reads less
